svg.title: Same synergy, different added information
svg.desc: Two exact systems with equal synergy log 4/3: an irrelevant second source adds no conditional mutual information, a completing source adds log 2, and the unique atom carries the difference.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: T = (A, B), S1 = A, S2 = U (independent)
T = (A, B), S1 = A, S2 = B
I(T; S2 | S1) = Unq2 + Syn = log 2
bars to scale: 100 units = 1 nat; the dashed line marks equal synergy; the difference lies in the added unique atom
